name: Nicholas
source: A sharp and observant student at Lind Academy, Nicholas is unsettled by a strange fog and a mysterious man who appears at a local café. Though his unease is dismissed by others, something about the encounter lingers. Convinced it wasn’t just in his head, he begins investigating on his own, determined to uncover the truth behind what he saw.
